title.narrative: Regional Artemisinin Initiative 2 Elimination (RAI2E) - South-Eastern Asia - Multicountry East Asia and Pacific RAI (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Multicountry East Asia and Pacific RAI, Malaria, United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS)This program has the following goals: Eliminate malaria by 2030 in all Greater Mekong Subregion countries and, considering the urgent action required against multidrug resistance in the GMS, to eliminate Plasmodium falciparum malaria by 2025. In areas where malaria transmission has been interupted, maintain malaria-free status and prevent reintroduction. The objectives of this program are: Interrupt tramsmission of P.f. in areas of multidrug resistance , including artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) resistance, by no later than 2020, and in all areas of the GMS by 2025. Reduce malaria in all high-transmission areas to less than 1 case per 1000 population at risk and initiate elimination activities by 2020. Prevent the reintroduction of malaria in areas where it has been interrupted.
